news.title: Iran declares Strait of Hormuz open to shipping but Trump says U.S. blockade still active
news.description: The Strait of Hormuz has remained almost completely closed as the U.S. and Iran have disputed the terms of their ceasefire agreement.

news.title: Fed Governor Waller says Iran war and labor market risks are keeping central bank on hold
